svg.text: Same coordinate frame and scale; each row shows its stated original or perturbed E/F. Pale = E, gray = F, colored = capture membership. Gold = original nucleus, black = reselected nucleus, magenta diamond = deletion.
X=.15 Euclidean connected capture · G=.15 graph-distance reference · B=one fixed rooted-edge capacity. Overlays show membership, not material masks.
X · G · B · same 3-cell raster scale in every panel; no per-case normalization.
